source.title: Genetic Mapping of Seven Kinds of Locus for Resistance to Asian Soybean Rust

quote: Asian soybean rust (ASR), caused by Phakopsora pachyrhizi, is one of the most serious soybean (Glycine max) diseases in tropical and subtropical regions. ... To facilitate the development of resistant varieties using gene pyramiding, DNA markers closely linked to seven resistance genes, namely, Rpp1, Rpp1-b, Rpp2, Rpp3, Rpp4, Rpp5, and Rpp6, were identified.
